[EN] The Crag Stalkers and Desert Fires are a pain, but no matter how many enemies try to fight their way into amani territory, we will never be enslaved again.

If you want to see the true ferocity of nature, try to take something—land, freedom, life—from an aman.
[ES] Los Crag Stalkers y Desert Fires son una molestia, pero no importa cuántos enemigos intenten abrirse paso a la fuerza en territorio amani, jamás volveremos a ser esclavizados.

Si quieres ver la verdadera ferocidad de la naturaleza, intenta quitarle algo —tierra, libertad, vida— a un aman.
